notes.title: Umbraclaw has been updated to Ver 1.2.1!
notes.notes:
(Updated June 28, 2024)
Ver 1.2.1

・An issue where the assignment for the Map button was not properly saved has been fixed.

notes.title: Umbraclaw has been updated to Ver 1.2.0!
notes.notes:
(Updated June 27, 2024)
Ver 1.2.0

・A new boss, "Azure Beast Gunvolt", has been added.
The new boss will appear in a specific place after clearing the game once.

・An issue where the upgrade "Breath of the Wild" decreased spirit gauge consumption more than intended has been fixed. 

・Various other small fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Trading Cards Are Now Available! - Umbraclaw
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Steam trading cards for "Umbraclaw" are now available!
Enjoy collecting your set!

notes.title: Umbraclaw has been updated to Ver 1.1.2!
notes.notes:
(Updated June 6, 2024)
Ver 1.1.2

・An issue where changes to button configuration would not properly save after closing the program has been fixed.

notes.title: Umbraclaw has been updated to Ver 1.1.1!
notes.notes:
(Updated May 31, 2024)
Ver 1.1.1

・An issue where text would not display properly on 4K monitors has been fixed.

notes.title: Umbraclaw Demo has been updated!
notes.notes:
Updated 2/6/2024

An issue where changing to some European languages would cause display issues or a crash has been fixed.
*The demo is currently only available in the following languages: English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), and Korean
